summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future: Zebu's depth snapshot (dk) gives a Depth frame with the quote, OI and the five-level book; a partial (df) moves the best levels and the OI; a book of zeros clears every level; the unsubscribe releases the depth subscription.

notes: Noren sends OI as oi and toi, and each member reads it as its web adapter does (audit FB-07): Zebu streams toi, Noren's total open interest, as total_traded_value. The partial carries an oi change without toi to show which one is read.
Circuits, the 52-week range and depth_level go out in Depth frames as the web sends them.

deviations.reason: The web's Zebu adapter merges every raw key into its scrip cache, so a packet that carries a new price and no time still goes out with Noren's old trade time ltt: a value of an earlier packet presented as this one's. The desktop sends a packet's times only from that packet, and a change worked out from the new price (lead decision, review-fixes.md: a per-packet time never carries over).

Noren's toi is the total open interest (Shoonya's adapter names it open_interest); the web's Zebu adapter sends it only as total_traded_value, a turnover name, so a client reading oi loses it. The desktop sends total_traded_value as the web does and keeps oi (lead ruling 2026-11-09).
